description: Navigate a minimalist grid to inflate and pop rhythmic enemies before they corner you.
rationale: This game focuses on spatial logic and timing. It targets casual gamers and provides a structured environment for AI agents to learn pathfinding and threat prioritization in a grid-based survival scenario.
details: A simplified clone of Dig Dug. The player operates on a 15x15 grid. The goal is to eliminate all enemies by either inflating them with a pump or dropping rocks on them. Enemies move randomly but start chasing the player when within a 4-tile radius. Digging through walls creates paths. The game ends if an enemy touches the player or if all enemies are defeated.

game_rules.rock_behavior: Falls after a 1-second delay if the space below is dug out

how_to_build: uv venv && uv pip install pygame numpy
how_to_play: Use ARROW KEYS to move and dig. Press SPACE to fire the pump towards an enemy; keep tapping SPACE to inflate them until they pop. Score +100 for popping an enemy, +500 for dropping a rock on an enemy. Avoid contact with enemies and fire breath.
